PORT.description: HTTP port inside this service. Keep the default to match its Railway public port and health check.

UPSTREAM_HOST.description: Upstream host resolved automatically from the linked service. Keep this reference when using the included topology.

UPSTREAM_PORT.description: Upstream port for otterwiki. The supplied value follows the pinned upstream deployment; change only with its configuration guide.

ACCESS_PASSWORD.description: Generated access password. Keep private and preserve with backups.

RAILWAY_DOCKERFILE_PATH.description: Repository-relative Dockerfile used to build this service. Keep the supplied path.

OWNER_AUTH.description: Require owner authentication for every application route.

SECRET_KEY.description: Generated secret key. Keep private and preserve with backups.

READ_ACCESS.description: Read access for app. The supplied value follows the pinned upstream deployment; change only with its configuration guide.

SERVER_NAME.description: Server name resolved automatically from the linked service. Keep this reference when using the included topology.

WRITE_ACCESS.description: Write access for app. The supplied value follows the pinned upstream deployment; change only with its configuration guide.

AUTO_APPROVAL.description: Auto approval for app. The supplied value follows the pinned upstream deployment; change only with its configuration guide.

ADMIN_USER_EMAIL.description: Email address to use for the first administrator signup behind the gateway.

ATTACHMENT_ACCESS.description: Attachment access for app. The supplied value follows the pinned upstream deployment; change only with its configuration guide.

EMAIL_NEEDS_CONFIRMATION.description: Email needs confirmation for app. The supplied value follows the pinned upstream deployment; change only with its configuration guide.
